name: usage-warn
description: Warns as the 5-hour and 7-day usage windows fill, with a pace forecast and a status line

start.title: Start warning at
start.description: The usage percent where warnings and the status line begin

step.title: Warn every
step.description: Percent between warnings after the start

notifyAt.title: Native notification from
notifyAt.description: From this percent a warning also raises a macOS notification; off for toasts only

toastSeconds.title: Toast seconds
toastSeconds.description: How long a warning toast stays on screen

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: on: past the start, keep usage, time to reset and the 100% forecast under the prompt

forecast.title: Pace forecast
forecast.description: on: say when the window hits 100% at the current pace, when that is before the reset

sevenDay.title: 7-day window
sevenDay.description: on: warn for the 7-day window too, with the same thresholds

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Play a chime with the native notification, on every warning, or never
